# Product Launch Checklist

## Strategy
- Audience and need defined.
- Positioning and key messages approved.
- Competitive context reviewed.
- Success metrics and baseline set.

## Readiness
- Product, price, and availability confirmed.
- Claims and legal requirements reviewed.
- Website, retail, partner, and support teams briefed.
- Creative and localized assets approved.
- Tracking and reporting tested.

## Launch operations
- Owners and escalation contacts confirmed.
- Timeline and contingency documented.
- Post-launch review scheduled.

Record blockers and go/no-go decisions explicitly.
